notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.

Fix for the V4 errors: a breadboard hole holds one lead only. The pot legs and the wire ends were sharing holes. Each now has its own hole in the same column strip: 24t.e (pot 5V leg) with 24t.d (red wire), 22t.e (pot GND leg) with 22t.d (black wire), 23b.f (pot wiper) with 23b.g (yellow wire). The circuit is electrically unchanged.

Breadboard rows: the image labels the upper half j-f and the lower half e-a, so the upper half is bank 'b' (rows f-j) and the lower half is bank 't' (rows a-e). The pot's center pin is in the upper half and its two outer pins in the lower half, as drawn.
Pot wiring follows the text: one outer pin to 5V, the other to GND, center pin to A0. The pot's VCC and GND ports are symmetric, so which outer pin goes where does not matter.

LED chain: pin 9 (blue wire, 3b.f) to the 220 ohm resistor (3b.g to 6b.g). The resistor shares strip 6b with the LED anode (6b.i). The LED cathode (8b.i) shares strip 8b with the black wire (8b.g) that goes to Arduino GND.
Exact column positions are estimated from the image. Which Arduino GND pin each black wire uses (GND.1 or GND.2) is an assumption, since all GND pins are the same node.
